name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 as regards the scope of the rules for benchmarks, the use in the Union of benchmarks provided by an administrator located in a third country, and certain reporting requirements
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's position on new rules for financial benchmarks. Benchmarks are the reference figures used to price things like loans, mortgages and investment funds. The changes adjust which benchmarks the rules cover, set conditions for using benchmarks run by companies based outside the European Union, and cut some reporting requirements. Parliament did not amend the text; it simply approved the deal already agreed with the Council, so the regulation can now become law.

- The rules now cover a narrower set of benchmarks, and some reporting duties are removed.
- Companies that run or use benchmarks, including non-EU providers, are affected.
- The act is adopted; it will be signed and published in the Official Journal.
